summary: PIM Manager Community now keeps itself up to date from the signed public release.

new.title: Community updates itself
new.text: PIM Manager Community updates itself at night from the signed public release, or when you start it by hand. Either way the release is checked before anything changes.

fixes.title: Single-tenant installs stay single-tenant
fixes.text: A single-tenant install no longer switches on MSP features.

fixes.title: Removed items stay hidden
fixes.text: Removed admins, groups and administrative units no longer show in reports, search or the Home counts.

fixes.title: No automatic major version jumps
fixes.text: An update never moves to a new major version on its own.
